newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RAVANELLI HAT-TRICK EASES MIDDLESBROUGH'S WOES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAVANELLI HAT-TRICK EASES MIDDLESBROUGH'S WOES.

text.p: Fabrizio Ravanelli scored a second-half hat-trick as Middlesbrough put their well-publicised troubles to one side and hammered Derby 6-1 in the English premier league on Wednesday night.
Ravanelli struck in the 54th, 82nd and 85th minutes as Bryan Robson's talent-laden side claimed their biggest league victory of the season.
Boro remained bottom of the table, however, three points behind Southampton, who clawed their way back from 2-0 down to draw 2-2 against Everton at the Dell.

Ravanelli's compatriot Benito Carbone scored twice as Sheffield Wednesday kept up their tremendous run by winning 3-0 at relegation-threatened Nottingham Forest. Dutchman Regi Blinker struck the Yorkshire side's other goal.

Wednesday, who face Wimbledon in the quarter-finals of the F.A. Cup, have lost just once in their last 22 matches. They moved into sixth place ahead of Ruud Gullit's Chelsea, who were held 1-1 at home by 1995 champions Blackburn.
In the night's other league match fifth-placed Aston Villa lost 1-0 at Leicester.
